payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the proposed NER model utilizes cross-lingual wikification, which allows for the grounding of words and phrases in non-English text to English Wikipedia entries. This process provides language-independent features that can be applied to named entities not explicitly listed on Wikipedia, as it leverages FreeBase types and Wikipedia categories for disambiguation.

claims.text: The NER model can account for named entities not listed on Wikipedia by using cross-lingual wikification to ground words to English Wikipedia entries.
Grounding words to Wikipedia allows the model to utilize FreeBase types and categories, which can provide information about entities not directly mentioned in Wikipedia.
